title: Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.31256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model's vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. translated_title: 面向投机解码直接最大化在策略期望接受长度
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提出候选token、再由目标模型进行验证，从而加速大语言模型推理。现有草稿模型训练通常优化token级分布对齐，但这并不能直接优化被接受前缀的长度：一旦某个草稿token被拒绝，其后所有草稿token都会被丢弃。我们提出FreDraft，一种在策略训练方法，直接最大化从当前草稿模型采样得到的草稿的期望接受长度。该目标考虑了首次拒绝截断，并引入前缀感知的信用分配，根据每个token对当前及后续token接受的贡献进行加权。为了高效优化该目标，我们解析地边缘化token级接受率，利用目标模型的词表分布来降低梯度方差。我们进一步重新分配该分布级梯度的一部分……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: FreDraft通过在策略训练直接最大化草稿的期望接受长度，并利用目标模型词表分布解析边缘化接受率以降低梯度方差，从而更有效地提升投机解码的加速效果。
